ezlo_app.title: Connect the Ezlo app
ezlo_app.description:
Allow Ezlo to show and control your devices?

The Ezlo app will reach your Home Assistant through your remote access address. To do that, Home Assistant creates an administrator user named **Ezlo** with an access token that only the Ezlo app holds. Your password is used once to sign in to the Ezlo app and is not stored.

You can revoke access at any time with **Disconnect Ezlo app** in this integration's options, or by deactivating the Ezlo user in Settings → People.

{error_detail}

restart_required_for_trusted_proxies.title: Add the trusted_proxies block to configuration.yaml
restart_required_for_trusted_proxies.description:
Ezlo Cloud HARC needs the Home Assistant HTTP component to trust the local frpc reverse proxy. Add the following block to your `configuration.yaml` and restart Home Assistant:

```yaml
http:
  use_x_forwarded_for: true
  trusted_proxies:
    - 127.0.0.1
```

This issue will close automatically the next time the integration loads and sees the block.

trial_ending_soon.title: Your Ezlo Cloud HARC free trial ends in {days} day(s)
trial_ending_soon.description:
Remote access through Ezlo Cloud HARC stops when your free trial ends. Subscribe before then to keep your remote URL working — use **Learn more**, or open the integration's **Configure** screen for the subscribe link. No payment details were collected during the trial.

This issue clears automatically once your subscription is active.

trial_expired.title: Your Ezlo Cloud HARC free trial has ended
trial_expired.description:
Your free trial is over and remote access has been disabled. Subscribe to restore it — use **Learn more**, or open the integration's **Configure** screen for the subscribe link.

This issue clears automatically once your subscription is active.
